item.tib: 'bar ba me phreng gi rgyud las tshogs mchod phun tshogs gter ldan
item.coloph: o rgyan bde chen gling pas shing stag zla ba drug pa'i dam can 'du ba'i rdzogs pa gsum gyi nyin la gnas chen seng ge gnam rdzong gi nye 'dabs rdo rje brag gi yongs (yang) rdzongs (rdzong) nas thon te/ phyis su lo gcig dang zla ba drug gi gsang rgya yol tshe bla khri wer ya drung mu shel bzhin dang tshul bzhin dgyes pa'i pra dz+nya sho ri sogs kyi thugs bzhed du zol ming pa des mkha' 'gro brda ba'i yi ge thar bde dben khrod du zhal bshus pas sngags kyi rnal 'byor yongs kyi tshogs rdzogs nas rgyal bstan phyogs kun rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
